name: SnapDeploy
line: Build and deploy containerized applications on AWS Fargate.

free.text: 4 Small containers, 100 pooled hours/mo; no card; then wait/pay

cells.regions: AWS US East compute; EU/India planned; Cloudflare delivery

work.math: $12 a month is the Small base. The free pool is only 100 running hours across the account. The full 730-hour cost adds unknown data sent out (100 GB) and tax, because transfer terms conflict.
$25 a month is the subscription base for 730 hours. The full total adds unknown data sent out (100 GB) and tax. Terms allow metered transfer, despite the flat-price page.

$25 for Medium + $49 for Postgres Standard = $74 a month base. The database has 2 GB RAM and 10 GB, with daily 30-day backups. Add unknown data sent out (100 GB), app-to-database traffic (10 GB) and tax.
